desc: drill happy path — descend a shaft, expose an adjacent ore, mine it (no gap/pillar). Success = DRILL_VEIN_REACHED (found the seeded vein, descended, exposed+started mining it) with no ERROR. NOT VEINS_DEPLETED: that's a persistence side-effect that fires only when the mining slice's `exhausted` flag is set (SCAN cycled cfg.scan.maxCycles dry) AND there are vein waypoints to grey out — the drill's happy path ends via DRILL_DEPTH_DONE→PAUSED (descend.ts), which never sets `exhausted`, so VEINS_DEPLETED is unreachable here (stale pre-EXCAVATE assertion, removed).
